No arrows, measurements or panel letters are present.

visual.general_description: Axial abdominal CT slice at the level of the kidneys with orientation letters, a centimeter scale and a red arrowhead.
visual.detailed_description: Axial grayscale CT slice through the upper abdomen at the level of both kidneys, with a vertebral body and spinal canal centered posteriorly. A yellow "R" is at the left edge and a yellow "L" at the right edge of the image, a vertical scale at the right edge is marked "10" at the top and "cm" at the bottom. A small red arrowhead points to the soft tissue immediately in front of and slightly to the image-right of the vertebral body. Anterior to the spine and between the kidneys there is a broad lobulated band of soft-tissue density around the central retroperitoneum and mesentery, with mottled gas and stool pattern in bowel at the image-left side. The vessels are not conspicuously brighter than the surrounding soft tissue. No panel letters, patient name or burned-in identifier text is visible.

visual.general_description: Color schematic of blood and brain compartments separated by an endothelial layer with labeled immune cells, antibodies and cytokines.
visual.detailed_description: Color schematic illustration with a pink strip labeled "Blood" below and a brain region labeled "Brain" above, separated by a row of endothelial cells joined by blue junction symbols. In the blood compartment are red cells, a monocyte labeled "Monocyte", T cells and B cells, and labels "aPL", "AECAs", "IL-6", "APRIL", "Anti-rRNP" and a TWEAK receptor-like symbol labeled "TWEAK". In the brain compartment are a neuron with a myelinated axon and labeled antibodies "Anti-AQP4", "Anti-rRNP" and "Anti-NMDAR", a dying neuron fragment labeled "cell death", an astrocyte labeled "astrocyte", a microglia labeled "Microglial activation", and clusters labeled "Immune complexes" with "TNF-α", "IL-6", "IL-8", "IP-10" and "MCP-1". Curved arrows connect blood T and B cells to brain T and B cells and to "IL-6", "TNF-γ" and "BAFF". There are no measured values, axes or patient identifiers.
